description: Once per Duel, during your Main Phase, you can shuffle 1 "Elemental HERO" monster you control into your Main Deck, then Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Elemental HERO" monster from your Main Deck with a different name than the shuffled card.
name: The Right Hero for the Job

description: Once per Duel, you can send 1 face-up "Tri-Blaze Accelerator" you control to the GY, then Special Summon 1 "Volcanic Doomfire" from your hand, Deck, or GY, ignoring its Summoning conditions. Your opponent takes no effect damage the turn you activate this Skill.
name: Volcanic Cannon

description:
Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Shuffle your entire hand into the Deck, then add 1 Level 11 monster from your Deck to your hand, and if you do, you can Special Summon up to 2 Level 7 monsters with different Attributes from your Deck and/or GY, but their ATK/DEF become 0, also their effects are negated. While you control "Gate Guardian", it gains the following effect.
● Once while face-up on the field, when this card is targeted for an attack: You can change the attacking monster's ATK to 0, until the end of the Damage Step.
name: Behold, Gate Guardian!

description:
Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these Skills based on the face-up monster(s) you control:
● "Elemental HERO": Discard 1 Trap, then add 1 Level 6 or lower Machine "roid" monster from your GY to your hand, then you can destroy 1 monster your opponent controls whose ATK is less than or equal to the added card's.
● Machine "roid": Discard 1 Spell, then Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower Machine "roid" or "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, but negate its effects.
 ● Both: Discard 1 card, then Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster using only "roid" and "Elemental HERO" monsters you control.
Each of these Skills can only be used once per Duel.
name: Believe in your Bro

description:
Apply the following Skills:
● You can Normal Summon Level 7 monsters for 1 less Tribute.
● You can Tribute Summon 1 Level 7 monster face-up, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.
● Your opponent takes no effect damage.
● You can only attack with 1 monster each turn, but that monster can make a second attack on monsters during each Battle Phase.
name: Beware the Brothers Paradox!

description:
Once per turn, you can place 1 counter on this card, then apply the appropriate effect depending on the number of counters on this card.
1: Discard 1 Dinosaur monster, then add 1 Dinosaur monster with a different Attribute from your Deck to your hand.
2: Normal Summon 1 WIND or WATER Dinosaur monster from your hand.
3: The names of all WATER Dinosaur monsters you currently control become "Hydrogeddon" (until the end of this turn), then add 1 "Bonding - H2O" from your Deck or GY to your hand.
4: Remove all counters from this card, then change the Attributes/Types of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls to FIRE/Pyro, until the end of this turn.
name: Chemistry in Motion

description: Once per turn, you can change 1 face-up "Koala" or "Kangaroo" monster's battle position. "Koala" and "Kangaroo" monsters you control can attack while in face-up Defense Position. If they do, apply their DEF for damage calculation.
name: Chillin' Outback

description:
Activate this Skill while your LP are 1000 or less. You can Normal Summon "Suijin", "Kazejin", or "Sanga of the Thunder" without Tributing this turn, OR, if you control "Suijin", "Kazejin", and "Sanga of the Thunder", you can apply this Skill instead.
● Send as many cards on the field as possible to the GY, then Special Summon 1 "Gate Guardian" from your Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
name: Elements of Thunder, Water, and Wind

description:
Once per turn, if you control a "HERO" Normal Monster or "HERO" Fusion Monster, you can discard 1 card to activate 1 of these Skills based on the Attribute(s) of that monster:
● EARTH: Destroy 1 EARTH monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.
● WIND: Destroy 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field.
● FIRE: Return all face-up non-FIRE Special Summoned monsters on the field to the hand.
● WATER: Draw 1 card, also until the end of the next turn, you can activate 1 Normal Trap Card from your hand.
● LIGHT: Change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on the field.
name: HERO World

description: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Discard 1 card, then Fusion Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material. If Summoning an "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster this way that requires 3 or more materials, and you control 2 "Elemental HERO" monsters that are mentioned on it as materials, you can also use monsters in your Deck as Fusion Material. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.
name: HEROES UNITE - FUSION!!

description: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Discard 1 card, then Fusion Summon 1 Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material. If you do, it gains ATK equal to its original ATK until the end of this turn, but it cannot attack your opponent directly this turn. During the End Phase of this turn, you take damage equal to the amount of ATK gained at the time of the Summon.
name: Power Bond (Skill Card)

description: Once per turn: You can target 1 other face-up card you control; destroy it, and if you do, add 1 "roid" card from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, when an attack is declared involving an opponent's monster and a "roid" monster you control: You can send 1 "roid" monster from your Deck to the GY; switch the original ATK and DEF of your battling monster during the damage calculation only.
name: Small Roid Big City

description:
Activate the following Skill(s).
● If a Ritual Summoned "The Masked Beast" you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect, you can Special Summon "Masked Beast Des Gardius" from your hand, Deck or GY, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
● You can Tribute 1 "Masked Beast Des Gardius", then add 1 "The Masked Beast" and 1 "Curse of the Masked Beast" from your Deck and/or GY to your hand.
Each of these Skills can only be used once per Duel.
name: Spell of Mask (Skill Card)

description: "Vehicroid Connection Zone" can be used to Fusion Summon any "roid" monsters from your Extra Deck. All "roid" monsters whose original Level is 6 or lower can be Normal Summoned/Set without Tributing. If a non-Fusion "roid" Machine monster you control whose original Level is 6 or lower attacks an opponent's monster, it gains ATK equal to its own Level x 100 during the Damage Step only. If you control a non-Machine monster, flip this card over.
name: The Roids are Alright

description:
Activate this Skill while you control "Hyozanryu". Once per turn, you can reveal the top 4 cards of your Deck, then if any of the following monsters are revealed, apply the appropriate Skills, in sequence. Then place the revealed cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order.
● "Carboneddon": 1 "Hyozanryu" you control gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.
● "Hydrogeddon": 1 "Hyozanryu" you control is unaffected by your opponent's monster effects, until the end of this turn.
● "Oxygeddon": Destroy 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, then inflict 800 damage to your opponent.
name: Under Pressure

description:
Apply the following Skills:
● Once per turn, you can send 1 Level 2 Zombie monster from your Deck to the GY and place 1 of your "The First Sarcophagus", "The Second Sarcophagus", or "The Third Sarcophagus" from your Deck, GY, or that is banished, face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. (This is treated as being placed by the effect of "The First Sarcophagus".)
● Each "Spirit of the Pharaoh" you control gains ATK equal to the total number of "Pharaoh's Servant" and "Pharaonic Protector" on your field and in your GY x 900.
name: Ancient Ruler Rises

description: You cannot Summon/Set non-Fiend monsters. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can roll a six-sided die. If you do, you lose LP equal to the result x 200, but if the result is 2, 3, or 4, you can Special Summon 1 "Archfiend" monster with a Level equal to the result from your hand, Deck, or GY.
name: Archfiend's Conscription

description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control "Vilepawn Archfiend" and your opponent controls no card in its same column, you can Tribute it to Special Summon 1 Level 8 or lower "Archfiend" monster from your hand or Deck that has "Queen", "Bishop" , "Rook", or "Knight" in its name.
name: Archfiend's Promotion

description: Each time a "Cloudian" monster with a Fog Counter(s) is destroyed, place its Fog Counters on another face-up monster on the field.
name: Cloudy Skies of Grey

description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can change the battle positions of monsters your opponent controls, up to the number of face-up Reptile monsters you control.
name: Cold-Blooded Tactician

description: Once per Duel, during your Main Phase, if you have 5 or more DARK monsters in your GY with different names and control no monsters, you can banish 1 DARK monster from your GY then Special Summon 1 DARK monster from your GY.
name: Dark Creation

description:
You can use "Super Polymerization" to Fusion Summon monsters that can normally only be Summoned with "Dark Fusion". Each of the following Skills can only be used once per Duel.
● Lose 2000 LP, then change the Type of 1 Special Summoned monster your opponent controls to Rock.
● Discard 1 card, then add 1 "Dark Fusion" from your Deck to your hand.
name: Dark Unity

description: During the End Phase, if a Zombie "Vampire" monster you control inflicted battle damage to your opponent this turn, gain LP equal to half the total battle damage your monsters inflicted to your opponent this turn.
name: Delicious Morsel!

description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can banish 1 Dragon Normal Monster from your GY to make 1 Dragon Normal Monster you control gain 200 ATK x that banished monster's Level until the end of this turn, also if it attacks a Defense Position monster this turn, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.
name: Dragon Force

description: Each time you place a Fog Counter(s) on a monster(s), give it an additional Fog Counter.
name: Fog Warning

description:
Once per Duel, during your Main Phase, you can change the name of 1 "Red-Eyes" monster or 1 Dragon Normal Monster you control to "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" while it's face-up on the field. Each "Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon" you control gains the following effect.
● Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Dragon monster from your GY that can be Normal Summoned/Set.
name: Forged Steel

description: Once per Duel, during your Main Phase, if you control "Don Zaloog", you can discard 1 card to Special Summon 2 "Dark Scorpion" monsters with different names from your hand and Deck (1 from each). "Don Zaloog" and "Dark Scorpion" monsters you control can attack directly, but when they do so using this Skill, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent becomes 400. You cannot Summon or Set any monsters except "Don Zaloog" and/or "Dark Scorpion" monsters.
name: No One Suspects the Dark Scorpion Gang!

description: While you control "Amazoness Queen", negate the effects of Effect Monsters destroyed by battle with attacking "Amazoness" monsters you control.
name: Order of the Queen

description: "Alchemy Beast Tokens" can attack directly. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can banish 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand or face-up field, to Special Summon 1 "Alchemy Beast Token" (Rock/Level 3/ATK 500/DEF 500), with the same Attribute as the banished monster. It cannot be Tributed, except for the face-up Tribute Summon of "Golden Homunculus".
name: Professor of Alchemy

description: Once per Duel, during your Main Phase, if you control an "Evil HERO" monster, you can discard 1 card to make 1 face-up monster your opponent controls lose ATK equal to its own DEF, or lose DEF equal to its own ATK (your choice).
name: Ruthless Means

description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control a monster whose ATK was ? in the Deck, you can banish 1 card from your hand, then add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand with ? ATK, but with a different name than the cards you control. "Helios" monsters you control cannot be banished.
name: Setting Sun

description: When you Special Summon "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", or "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms" using the method mentioned on that card, you can use face-up Fiend monsters, Continuous Spells, and/or Continuous Traps you control, regardless of the card type the text requires.
name: Unlocking the Power

description:
Once per Duel, during your Main Phase, you can change the name of 1 Zombie "Vampire" monster you control to "Vampire Lord" while it's face-up on the field. Each "Vampire Genesis" you control gains the following effect.
● If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 card in your opponent's GY; Set it to your field.
name: Vampiric Aristocracy

description: When this Skill is activated, add 1 "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", or "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms" from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, you can discard 1 card, then Special Summon 1 Fiend monster with 0 ATK/DEF from your GY.
name: Victory of the Shadow Riders

description: After damage calculation, if you took battle damage from a battle involving an opponent's monster and your Attack Position "Amazoness" monster, that opponent's monster loses ATK/DEF equal to the ATK of the "Amazoness" monster it battled, until the end of this turn.
name: Welcome to the Jungle

name: Ulevo

name: Meteo the Matchless

name: King of Destruction - Xexex

name: Queen of Fate - Eternia

name: Testament of the Arcane Lords

name: Chimaera, the Master of Beasts

name: Emperor of Lightning
